description: Cross-registry correlation daemon. For each server in mcp_server_registry: cross-reference across multiple threat intelligence sources passively: (1) PhishTank API: GET https://checkurl.phishtank.com/checkurl/ with url, (2) URLVoid: GET https://api.urlvoid.com/v1/{API_KEY}/host/{domain}/ if URLVOID_API_KEY set, (3) AbuseIPDB: check host IP GET https://api.abuseipdb.com/api/v2/check?ipAddress={ip}&key={key}, (4) Maltiverse: GET https://api.maltiverse.com/hostname/{hostname}, (5) Cross-reference server_id against known threat feeds in world_articles table: ws_query world_articles WHERE topics LIKE '%mcp%' AND title ILIKE '%malicious%' or '%supply chain%'. All APIs: graceful skip if key not set. Rate limit: 1 req/sec. Any positive hit: ws_write mcp_threat_associations severity=CRITICAL, set verdict=KNOWN_THREAT via ws_write mcp_server_registry update. Poll 86400s. Heartbeat.
